read_only_note: Derived artifact. Raw evidence (metadata.json, samples.jsonl, engine-increment.log, summary.json) is unchanged. Every value below was re-derived from those files plus the byte-range recheck; see final-validation.log and audit_final.py.

errors.gpu_unavailable_node_counter_kind: ENOENT on absent AMD-style mem_info_* files for other/virtual DRM nodes (evdi/* and non-Radeon cards); NOT Radeon faults or zero values

request_throughput.mean_definition_warning: unweighted_mean_of_row_rates is the arithmetic mean of the per-row printed rates. It is NOT aggregate weighted throughput (total tokens / total time). Do not equate the two.
request_throughput.withdrawn_claim: Earlier partial-report 'decode 9.6-158.1' mixed up the PP column (first row PP=158.1). It is withdrawn; the raw collector stores only raw lines and was not at fault.

raw_increment_integrity.live_source_note: The live source keeps growing (size 4547518 then 4560229 across rechecks). Only the declared 37222-byte range was compared; the whole live log was never hashed and is excluded from the seal as immutable evidence.

limitations: Zero evicted is a statement about the 121 30-second observations, NOT proof of continuous zero over the hour; transient between-sample migrations may be missed.
No matched before/after request traces, so no causal or sustained-recovery claim is supported.
The historic 5-8 tok/s severe slowdown/stall was NOT reproduced in these 26 completions; the observed TG 10.7-25.4 must not be labelled 'normal' and performance is not shown to be fixed.
Request observation timestamps bound byte arrival in the log, not execution time.
The earlier 1.38 GiB card2 slow-epoch driver eviction remains independent valid evidence.
GPU acceptance is NOT lifted; game experiment parked; quality/context/precision/tolerances and the 2560 MiB floor unchanged; no promotion.
